item.title: Why Problem-Finding Is Becoming the Real Differentiator in Communications
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260213102549_022625Purposeful.webp" alt="Purposeful" />While finding the right solution to a problem is still important, the work that differentiates effective communications leaders is <em>problem-finding</em>&mdash;identifying the real risk before it becomes visible, reputational or irreversible.</p>
